purpose: Wave-4 diaries/outfits package: high-value skilling outfits, diary doubling (New Varrock), modified diviner head, enhanced yaktwee, Ports scrimshaw crafter facility, DG ring of kinship + warped gorajan trailblazer, volcanic trapper elite Hunter set, Hunter XP outfit (Arc/Waiko), and master-thief toolbelt tools. Complements wave4-critical-tools (which deferred kandarin:modified-diviners-headwear to this file) and thinner activity stubs in ironman-unlocks without re-emitting thin pointers as the sole record.

policy.region_rule: region_hint is practical acquisition geography for League planning. region_hints list support pressure. Never put multi-region/cross-region/global as a fake region except explicit cross-region: ids for fragment elites.
policy.duplicate_guard: Full equipment rows for thin activity stubs (elder divination, infinity ethereal) and missing outfit ids. kandarin:fishing-outfit already exists in ironman-gaps — re-emitted here as the wave4 package row with same id and full effects for diaries-outfits completeness. misthalin:thieves-guild-master-tools already exists — this file adds asgarnia:toolbelt-master-thief-tools only if treated as toolbelt-attach framing; wiki acquisition is Misthalin Thieves' Guild (tagged asgarnia per wave4 id list; league_treatment corrects).
policy.outfit_rule: Gameplay acquisition only. Prefer Invention fragments / Cache / Fish Flingers / Stealing Creation / Waiko chimes / Construction Contracts / Archaeology Guild over Treasure Hunter or DXP Token Store.
policy.rate_rule: No invented XP/hour. Unlock state, costs, and wiki-stated percent effects only.
policy.no_trade_rule: Ironman permanent unlocks that change outfit XP, gather QoL, DG economy, RC inventory, or Thieving toolbelt.

activity_additions.name: Scrimshaw Crafter (Player-owned port workshop)
activity_additions.category: permanent Ports Fletching scrimshaw craft facility
requirements: Player-owned port access (Port Sarim / Ports hub)
Refitted workshop upgrade (500 black slate + 2,000 bamboo) to unlock the Scrimshaw Crafter device
Minimum 85 Fletching for lowest scrimshaws; higher tiers to 95 Fletching for combat scrimshaws
Ancient bones + appropriate completed Ports scroll for each scrimshaw recipe
unlocks: Workshop Scrimshaw Crafter craft interface for all standard and superior skilling and combat scrimshaws
Skilling scrimshaws: log-splitting, rock-crushing, tree-shaking, gem-finding, whopper-baiting, casket-salvaging, memory-crushing, energy-gathering (and superior variants)
Combat scrimshaws (attack/ranging/magic/cruelty/elements/vampyrism/aggression/corruption/sacrifice lines and superior forms)
Base craft XP 4,000 Fletching per scrimshaw before workshop XP modifiers
Workshop tier XP bonus: +5% Fletching XP on crafter at refitted, scaling to +20% at revamped workshop
region_pressure: Asgarnia hard: Port Sarim player-owned port workshop is the facility home (Equilibrium Arc/Ports taxonomy is Asgarnia-local).
Desert optional: Menaphos/Eastern trade-goods pressure and ancient-bones supply loops; not required to place the crafter itself.
Id prefix desert: retained for wave4 audit list; planner should treat asgarnia as hard gate for the workshop.
activity_additions.notes: Facility row, not a wearable. Complements asgarnia:player-owned-ports-skilling activity pointer. Ancient bones from Ports voyages; do not invent voyage rates. Superior combat scrimshaws may require inactive base + bones.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Asgarnia for Port Sarim workshop. Desert id is audit-tag only — require Asgarnia for unlock.
